apply_instructions: Merge native_sidecar_patch into the newly exported revision sidecar after the existing sidecar.py step. Preserve exporter-owned source/hash/materials/structures/roles/um_per_bu and catalog descriptions. Put final <stem>.viewer.json beside matching GLB. Never rename original 28 identities. Teach metadata/manual sections is separate documentation; no native label or section automation is claimed.

labels.control: Labels / L names every visible part. Selection and Frame focus one item; matching catalog supplies descriptions.
labels.opening: off via GLB view default; no supported per-camera labels default in sidecar
labels.unsupported_claim: part_descriptions is not read by GLB model loader; must retain matching catalog metadata through later authorized selector integration.

cutaway.cut_on_false_purpose: Reset stale manual sections each named view. It does not create a cutaway. GLB Model has no authored procedural cutaway planes in this revision.
